local-semantic-consequence.name: Local semantic consequence
local-semantic-consequence.asks: From the changed repo alone, can the tool infer that a local default or rewrite changes a domain decision — not only that a field has a new value?

cross-repo-impact.name: Cross-repo impact
cross-repo-impact.asks: When sibling repos are in context, can the tool connect a local contract change to a named downstream consumer?

contract-leak.name: Public contract leak
contract-leak.asks: Can the tool see that a public response or nested object now exposes internal or forbidden fields?

abstraction-bypass.name: Published-contract bypass
abstraction-bypass.asks: Can the tool flag a consumer reading producer internals — a leaked envelope or a nested walk — instead of the agreed public field?

display-vs-authority.name: Display vs authoritative state
display-vs-authority.asks: Can the tool reject treating a presentation or display value as the source of truth for a decision or side effect?

omitted-guard-as-true.name: Omitted guard treated as true
omitted-guard-as-true.asks: Can the tool catch logic that treats a missing confirmation or guard flag as granted?

kind-relabel.name: Outcome kind relabel
kind-relabel.asks: Can the tool catch a classification change that files or publishes one outcome under another kind?

leak-propagation.name: Leak persistence or pass-through
leak-propagation.asks: Can the tool see that storing or forwarding an internal envelope keeps leaked fields beyond the producer?
